spanish: Y será a ustedes a guarda hasta catorce día a este mes, y lo degollarán toda asamblea de congregación de Israel entre las tardes.

findings.issue: Dual absolute evenings is plural tardes; entre las tardes keeps the open between-the-evenings phrase and does not reduce it to one time of day.

notes: Clause roles, fourteen as one day, 2mp ustedes, and 3cp slaughter by the assembly of the congregation of Israel stay inside the tokens.
